Use These 7 AI Image Prompts to Create Stunning Realistic Photos

Want to create realistic photos with AI? Try these 7 detailed image prompts to generate professional portraits, lifestyle photography, cinematic scenes, and lifelike images using your favorite AI image generator.

By LokkeeVerse · 7 min read

Introduction

Creating realistic images with artificial intelligence is becoming easier, but the quality of your results often depends on the prompt you use. A short instruction may produce an ordinary image, while a detailed prompt can help an AI image generator understand the subject, lighting, camera angle, background, and overall photography style you want.

Whether you use ChatGPT's image generation, Google Gemini, Midjourney, Leonardo AI, or another image generator, the seven prompts in this guide can help you experiment with more realistic-looking results.

You do not need to be a professional photographer. Simply copy a prompt, paste it into your preferred AI image generator, and adjust the details to suit your idea.

1. Create a Stunning Realistic Portrait

Use this prompt when you want a lifelike portrait suitable for profile pictures, creative projects, or social media.

Prompt:

Create an ultra-realistic professional portrait photograph of a young adult standing near a large window in a modern studio. Natural sunlight softly illuminates the face, revealing realistic skin texture, fine facial details, natural eyes, and individual strands of hair. Use a 85mm portrait lens look, shallow depth of field, soft background blur, balanced natural colors, realistic shadows, and professional editorial photography. The expression should feel relaxed and authentic. Avoid plastic-looking skin, excessive retouching, distorted facial features, and artificial lighting.

Best for: Profile pictures, professional portraits, creator branding, and realistic character concepts.

2. Generate a Luxury Lifestyle Photo

This prompt is useful for creating polished lifestyle images with a premium photography aesthetic.

Prompt:

Create a photorealistic lifestyle photograph of a stylish young adult relaxing in a luxurious modern apartment with floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking a city skyline. Soft morning sunlight enters the room, creating realistic highlights and shadows across the furniture and clothing. Include natural body posture, authentic fabric textures, subtle skin details, tasteful interior design, cinematic composition, and high-end magazine photography. Use a natural color palette, realistic proportions, and a 35mm lens look. The scene should feel like a genuine photograph captured by a professional lifestyle photographer.

Best for: Lifestyle blogs, social media content, mood boards, and editorial concepts.

3. Create a Cinematic Street Photography Image

Want an image that looks like a scene from a movie? Try this prompt.

Prompt:

Create a highly realistic cinematic street photograph of a busy city street shortly after rainfall at blue hour. Reflections from shop windows and streetlights shimmer on the wet pavement. Pedestrians move naturally through the scene, wearing realistic everyday clothing. Capture atmospheric depth, subtle motion blur in the background, accurate reflections, realistic lighting, detailed buildings, and natural human proportions. Use a 35mm documentary photography style, balanced contrast, rich but believable colors, and a composition that feels spontaneous rather than staged. Avoid exaggerated neon effects and artificial-looking people.

Best for: Cinematic backgrounds, storytelling, creative projects, and urban photography concepts.

4. Generate a Realistic Fashion Photograph

You can use AI to explore fashion photography concepts without arranging a physical photoshoot.

Prompt:

Create a photorealistic fashion editorial photograph of an adult model wearing a sophisticated contemporary outfit in a minimalist architectural setting. The clothing should have realistic stitching, fabric folds, accurate material textures, and natural movement. Use soft directional studio lighting, subtle shadows, a confident natural pose, and a professional fashion magazine composition. Capture detailed clothing textures, realistic skin, natural facial proportions, and a clean neutral background. The final image should resemble a high-quality fashion campaign photographed with a professional full-frame camera.

Best for: Fashion concepts, clothing inspiration, editorial mockups, and creative branding.

5. Make Food Look Delicious and Real

Food photography can benefit from detailed descriptions of textures, lighting, and presentation.

Prompt:

Create an ultra-realistic professional food photograph of a freshly prepared meal served on a beautiful ceramic plate on a wooden restaurant table. Show natural food textures, subtle steam rising from the hot dish, fresh ingredients, realistic highlights from soft window lighting, and gentle shadows. Include small authentic details such as seasoning, moisture, and natural variations in the food. Use a close-up composition, shallow depth of field, appetizing but realistic colors, and high-end restaurant menu photography. Avoid artificial gloss, exaggerated saturation, and perfectly uniform ingredients.

Best for: Food blogs, restaurant design concepts, recipe content, and social media posts.

6. Create a Realistic Travel Photograph

Use this prompt to explore travel photography concepts featuring beautiful destinations.

Prompt:

Create a photorealistic travel photograph of a beautiful coastal town during golden hour. Warm sunlight illuminates traditional buildings, narrow streets, and the ocean in the distance. Include realistic architectural details, natural atmospheric haze, believable reflections, accurate perspective, and a few people walking naturally through the scene. Use professional travel photography composition, balanced exposure, natural colors, and a wide-angle lens look. The photograph should feel like an authentic image captured during a real journey, not a fantasy illustration or heavily edited postcard.

Best for: Travel blogs, destination concepts, social media content, and visual storytelling.

7. Generate a Professional Product Photograph

This prompt can help you create product photography concepts for advertising and online stores.

Prompt:

Create a photorealistic commercial product photograph of a premium wireless headphone displayed on a clean modern surface against a soft light-gray background. Use professional studio lighting with realistic highlights, controlled shadows, accurate material textures, fine surface details, and a polished commercial composition. The product should be sharply focused, with a subtle background gradient and natural reflections. Use a high-resolution product photography aesthetic, realistic proportions, and clean color balance. Do not add logos, text, extra buttons, or decorative elements that are not specified.

Best for: Product concepts, advertising mockups, e-commerce design drafts, and promotional visuals.

Tips for Getting Better Results From AI Image Generators

  • Describe the subject clearly. Specify what you want the image to show.
  • Add lighting details. Natural window light, golden hour, and soft studio lighting can produce different moods.
  • Describe the camera style. A portrait lens look, wide-angle composition, or close-up framing can guide the image's appearance.
  • Mention realistic textures. Skin, hair, fabric, wood, glass, and metal benefit from specific descriptions.
  • Avoid contradictory instructions. For example, do not request both deep focus across the entire scene and an extremely shallow depth of field.
  • Generate multiple variations. Compare the results and refine the prompt based on what works.
  • Check the details. AI-generated text, hands, jewelry, product controls, and small background elements may contain errors.

Which AI Image Generator Should You Try?

You can experiment with these prompts in several popular tools:

  • ChatGPT image generation — useful for creating images from conversational instructions.
  • Google Gemini — offers image-generation capabilities in supported experiences.
  • Midjourney — popular for artistic, stylized, and photorealistic image creation.
  • Leonardo AI — offers image-generation tools and creative controls.

Features, access, and pricing may change, so check each service before choosing one.

Final Thoughts

Realistic AI images start with clear instructions. These seven prompts give you a practical starting point for creating portraits, lifestyle photography, cinematic scenes, fashion images, food photos, travel visuals, and product concepts.

For the best results, treat each prompt as a starting point rather than a fixed formula. Change the setting, subject, lighting, clothing, or camera style to develop your own visual ideas.

Try one of the prompts today and compare the results. You may discover a new style for your content, website, or creative projects.
